categories.title: Absolutely Prohibited Items
categories.description: These items cannot be brought into Kenya under any circumstances

items.law: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (Control) Act

items.item: Endangered species products (ivory, rhino horn, etc.)
items.law: CITES / Wildlife Conservation and Management Act

items.item: Genetically modified organisms without KEPHIS approval

categories.title: Restricted Items (Permit Required)
categories.description: These items may be imported with the appropriate permit or license

items.item: Used motor vehicles (must be under 8 years old)

items.law: Proceeds of Crime and Anti-Money Laundering Act

categories.title: Traveller Duty-Free Allowances
categories.description: Items you can bring into Kenya without paying duty, subject to limits

categories.title: Mandatory Declaration Items
categories.description: You must declare these items to Customs upon arrival

items.item: Cash exceeding KES 1,000,000 (or equivalent in foreign currency)

items.requirement: Declare at Red Channel for duty assessment
Import Declaration Form (IDF) via KRA iTax
Declare with valid Kenya firearms certificate
Veterinary health certificate from country of origin
Phytosanitary certificate from country of origin

notes: Kenya uses the Red/Green channel system at international airports
Green Channel: Nothing to declare (within duty-free allowances)
Red Channel: Goods to declare or goods exceeding allowances
Penalties for non-declaration include seizure, fines, and potential prosecution
EAC citizens (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, DRC, South Sudan) may have different allowances
All commercial imports require an Import Declaration Form (IDF) via KRA iTax before shipment
